title: VectifyAI/PageIndex
title_zh: PageIndex 是一个无向量、基于推理的 RAG 引擎，能够实现可追踪、可解释和上下文相关的检索，

paragraphs.en: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
paragraphs.zh: 📑 PageIndex：面向无向量、基于推理的 RAG 的文档索引

paragraphs.en: Reasoning-based RAG ◦ No Vector DB, No Chunking ◦ Context-Aware Retrieval ◦ Reads Like a Human
paragraphs.zh: 基于推理的 RAG ◦ 无需向量数据库，无需分块 ◦ 上下文感知检索 ◦ 像人类一样阅读

paragraphs.en: Are you frustrated with vector database retrieval accuracy for long and complex documents? Vector-based RAG retrieves by semantic similarity . But similarity ≠ relevance — what retrieval actually needs is relevance, and relevance requires reasoning . On professional documents that demand contextual understanding, domain expertise, and multi-step reasoning, similarity search misses what is relevant but not similar, and returns what is similar but not relevant.
paragraphs.zh: 你是否为向量数据库在处理冗长复杂文档时检索准确率不佳而感到沮丧？ 基于向量的 RAG 通过语义相似度进行检索。 但相似 ≠ 相关 —— 检索真正需要的是相关性，而相关性需要推理。 在需要上下文理解、领域专业知识和多步推理的专业文档上，相似度搜索会漏掉相关但不相似的内容，并返回相似但不相关的内容。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by AlphaGo, PageIndex replaces the vector index with a hierarchical tree index and lets an LLM reason its way through it, the way a human expert turns to and reads the right section of a long report. Retrieval happens in two steps:

paragraphs.en: It is ideal for financial reports, legal documents, regulatory filings, technical manuals, medical literature, academic textbooks, and any other long, complex professional document.
paragraphs.zh: 它非常适合用于财务报告、法律文件、监管申报文件、技术手册、医学文献、学术教科书以及其他任何冗长复杂的专业文档。

paragraphs.en: pip install -U pageindex import os from pageindex import PageIndexClient os . environ [ "OPENAI_API_KEY" ] = "your-openai-key" client = PageIndexClient ( index = "gpt-6-luna" , # model to build the tree index chat = "gpt-6-sol" , # model to search the tree ) doc_id = client . submit_document ( "report.pdf" )[ "doc_id" ] answer = client . chat ( "What was the 2023 operating margin?" , doc_id = doc_id ) print ( answer ) Model Recommendations index= : a basic model is sufficient. The tree structure itself is extracted from the document layout without an LLM; the index model only summarizes and refines it, which a basic model does well. chat= : use the best model you can afford. The chat model searches the tree to retrieve information. See Query cost and accuracy . Have a Claude subscription? PageIndex can use your subscription to call Claude models through Claude Code: usage is covered by your plan, no API key needed. Install with pip install -U "pageindex[claude]" , then prefix model names with claude-code/ , e.g., index="claude-code/haiku" , chat="claude-code/opus" (see example ).
paragraphs.zh: pip install -U pageindex import os from pageindex import PageIndexClient os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"] = "your-openai-key" client = PageIndexClient(index="gpt-6-luna", # 用于构建树状索引的模型 chat="gpt-6-sol", # 用于搜索树的模型) doc_id = client.submit_document("report.pdf")["doc_id"] answer = client.chat("2023 年的营业利润率是多少？", doc_id=doc_id) print(answer) 模型推荐 index=：使用基础模型即可。 树结构本身是从文档布局中提取的，无需大语言模型；索引模型只负责总结和细化它，基础模型就能做得很好。chat=：使用你能负担得起的最好的模型。 聊天模型会搜索树来检索信息。 参见「查询成本与准确率」。 你有 Claude 订阅吗？ PageIndex 可以使用你的订阅，通过 Claude Code 调用 Claude 模型：用量由你的套餐覆盖，无需 API 密钥。 使用 pip install -U "pageindex[claude]" 安装，然后在模型名称前加上 claude-code/ 前缀，例如 index="claude-code/haiku"、chat="claude-code/opus"（参见示例）。

paragraphs.en: Building a tree locally runs about $0.001 per page with gpt-5.6-luna as the index model, so a 1,000-page textbook costs a little over a dollar and a few minutes, once, and every later question reuses it. PageIndex is designed not to rely heavily on the model used at index time, so in our experiments a basic model does not hurt quality.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 gpt-5.6-luna 作为索引模型，在本地构建一棵树的成本约为每页 0.001 美元，因此一本 1,000 页的教科书只需花费一美元多一点和几分钟时间，且仅需一次，之后的每次提问都可以复用它。 PagePage 的设计并不重度依赖索引时所使用的模型，因此在我们的实验中，使用基础模型也不会损害质量。

paragraphs.en: Indexing time also scales predictably with document length. In the same local setup, the benchmark documents (9 to 1,098 pages) finished in roughly 13 seconds to 4.5 minutes .
paragraphs.zh: 索引时间也随文档长度呈可预测的增长。 在相同的本地环境中，基准文档（9 至 1,098 页）的处理耗时大约为 13 秒到 4.5 分钟。

paragraphs.en: Query cost and accuracy PageIndex Financial QA Benchmark compares the accuracy and query cost of 34 configurations of 19 LLMs answering 100 questions over 40 Form 10-K filings from 8 companies, with PageIndex doing the retrieval. Cost is measured per 100-question run and excludes one-time indexing.
paragraphs.zh: 查询成本与准确率：PageIndex 金融问答基准测试比较了 19 个大语言模型的 34 种配置在回答 8 家公司 40 份 10-K 表格中的 100 个问题时的准确率与查询成本，检索由 PageIndex 完成。 成本按每次 100 个问题的运行计算，不包含一次性索引的费用。

paragraphs.en: The alternative to retrieval is handing the model the whole PDF on every question. That cost grows with the document; PageIndex's does not, because it reads only the nodes its reasoning reaches. On documents where both routes return the same answer, native PDF input costs 2.1× more at 52 pages and 16.6× more at 420 ( gpt-5.6-sol , prompt caching excluded) — and at 805 pages the document no longer fits in the context window at all.
paragraphs.zh: 检索的替代方案是每次提问时都把整个 PDF 交给模型。 这种成本随文档大小增长；而 PageIndex 的成本不会，因为它只读取其推理所到达的节点。 在两条路径都返回相同答案的文档上，原生 PDF 输入在 52 页时成本高出 2.1 倍，在 420 页时高出 16.6 倍（gpt-5.6-sol，不含提示词缓存）——而到 805 页时，文档已经完全无法装进上下文窗口了。

paragraphs.en: Leading accuracy on FinanceBench PageIndex reached a state-of-the-art 98.7% accuracy on FinanceBench (financial document QA benchmark), vastly outperforming vector-based RAG.
paragraphs.zh: PageIndex 在 FinanceBench（金融文档问答基准测试）上达到了最先进的 98.7% 准确率，大幅领先基于向量的 RAG。

paragraphs.en: Explore the full FinanceBench evaluation results and the blog post .
paragraphs.zh: 探索完整的 FinanceBench 评估结果和博客文章。

paragraphs.en: The open-source version is ideal for text-heavy PDFs and local workflows. With PageIndex Cloud, document indexing and storage run in the cloud : PageIndex handles parsing, OCR, image understanding, tree-index construction, and managed storage for you. The chat and retrieval layer remains compatible with your model , so you can search the cloud-hosted index using the model provider your application already uses.
paragraphs.zh: 开源版本非常适合以文本为主的 PDF 和本地工作流。 使用 PageIndex Cloud，文档索引和存储都在云端运行：PageIndex 为您处理解析、OCR、图像理解、树状索引构建和托管存储。 聊天和检索层仍与您的模型兼容，因此您可以使用应用程序已在使用的模型提供商来搜索云端托管的索引。
